children: AbbVie, Inc. (NYSE:ABBV) reported strong Phase III CERVINO results for etentamig with higher ORR, lower progression risk and improved 12‑month OS, confirmed a blood‑cancer primary endpoint, stuck to 2026 EPS guidance, added immunology assets and launched SkinMedica Barrier Calming Cream.
: AbbVie’s etentamig Phase 3 CERVINO (n=393) showed 74.0% ORR vs 45.7% standard, 60% lower progression/death risk (HR 0.40), and 12‑month OS 87.9% vs 72.0%. Monthly outpatient T‑cell therapy.
: AbbVie (ABBV) reaffirmed 2026 adjusted EPS guidance $13.87–$14.07 and Q3 adjusted EPS $3.84–$3.88; Apogee acquisition adds $0.14 dilutive impact and $0.58 per share from acquired IPR&D/milestones.
AbbVie Blood Cancer Drug Phase III Endpoints
: AbbVie (ABBV) said its blood cancer drug met primary endpoints in a Phase III trial, confirming the therapy achieved the study’s main efficacy goals for the treated indication.
: AbbVie (ABBV) added two immunology drugs via deal: zumilokibart, a late‑stage IL‑13 antibody, and APG273, an IL‑13+TSLP combo; both may enable long‑acting dosing—news relevant for traders.
: AbbVie’s Allergan Aesthetics launched SkinMedica Barrier Calming Cream. Clinical tests show ~30% reduced dryness in two weeks; aims to boost barrier resilience and retinol tolerance.
